sectors.trend: Iron ore crash confirmed; China demand pivot and Trump trade policy weigh on pricing. Offsetting: Critica 19Mt tin-tungsten discovery, Forrestania 2Mt gold deal, Sarytogan 97.7% battery-grade graphite yield, PLC Resources WA gold target. Steelworks job losses signal structural weakness.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin compression. Small/mid-cap miners (CRCA.AX, FRT.AX, SRY.AX, PLC.AX) offer selective upside. Diversify away from pure iron ore exposure.

sectors.trend: Oil spike on Houthi Hormuz control; fuel price blowout pressures Albanese for second excise cut. Australia nears energy inflection point. Bowen in Saudi for fuel supply. Shipping giant installs 35m sail to cut fuel costs.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from higher oil. Airlines (QAN.AX) and transport face cost pressure. Energy transition stocks gain policy tailwind.

sectors.trend: Fed meeting in focus; RBA rate path uncertain amid oil-driven inflation. House prices falling pressures mortgage growth and REIT valuations. Fuel excise cut debate adds fiscal pressure.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face NIM compression if RBA holds. REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) under pressure from falling property values.

sectors.trend: Major private hospital operator breakup via lender-backed consortium bid signals sector consolidation. CSL.AX remains defensive anchor.
sectors.implications: Consolidation creates M&A opportunities. CSL.AX, SGH.AX, IAG.AX (health insurance) benefit from defensive rotation.

sectors.trend: AI theme dominant: Trump vs tech chiefs, Adobe AI revenue inflection, CrowdStrike autonomous product, IBEX AI pivot, AI agents via Visa/Mastercard. ASX tech laggards face global spillover.
sectors.implications: Global AI momentum supports sentiment but regulatory risk (Trump 'SICK conspiracy' rhetoric) adds volatility. ASX-listed tech (WTC.AX, XRO.AX) benefit from global AI capex cycle.

sectors.trend: Coffeehouse Chapter 11, steakhouse chain closing 40+ locations signal consumer squeeze. Falling house prices attract young buyers but hurt REIT valuations. Fuel costs pressure discretionary spend.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin pressure. REITs (GPW.AX, SPG.AX) under valuation pressure. Defensive staples preferred.

key_themes: Iron ore crash and China demand pivot
Immigration policy and labour supply debate
Housing market correction and REIT pressure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price crash / China demand collapse
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX weight; rotate to gold (NVS.AX, GSN.AX) and battery metals (SRY.AX)
Hedge with energy equities (WDS.AX, WLE.AX); monitor Brent crude; consider fuel-linked inflation hedges
Maintain cash buffer; avoid leveraged positions; favour quality earnings (CSL.AX, CBA.AX)
Monitor CPI data; favour rate-sensitive REITs only if RBA pivots; hold short-duration bonds

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Immigration policy disruption / labour supply shock
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid construction/infrastructure names exposed to labour shortages; monitor construction sector (WBC.AX, GPT.AX)
Underweight residential REITs; favour industrial/healthcare REITs; monitor core loan-to-value

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy equities on oil spike and supply risk
opportunities.rationale: Houthi Hormuz control and fuel blowout support upstream margins; Bowen Saudi trip signals policy support

opportunities.recommendation: Selective mining rotation to gold and battery metals
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore crash diverts capital; Forrestania, Sarytogan, PLC Resources offer discovery-driven upside; gold hedges geopolitical risk
Private hospital operator breakup signals sector M&A wave; defensive income in volatile market
Adobe, CrowdStrike, IBEX show AI revenue inflection; ASX tech laggards benefit from global capex cycle

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore and China-exposed materials weight
defensive_moves.rationale: Confirmed iron ore crash and China policy pivot threaten BHP/RIO/FMG earnings for 2-3 quarters

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight residential REITs and consumer discretionary
defensive_moves.rationale: Falling house prices, fuel cost blowout, and consumer squeeze (coffeehouse/steakhouse closures) pressure valuations

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain 10-15% cash allocation amid stock shock risk
defensive_moves.rationale: Wall Street red, ASX sliding, oil volatility, and Fed uncertainty create elevated short-term risk

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely to remain under pressure over 1-3 months. Iron ore crash, oil-driven inflation, and global tech volatility cap upside. RBA on hold but hawkish bias. Expect 3-5% downside risk to ^AXJO. Energy and gold outperform; materials and consumer lag.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive if iron ore stabilises and AI capex cycle sustains. Energy transition inflection and healthcare consolidation create structural opportunities. Immigration policy resolution critical for labour supply and productivity. Housing correction may create entry points for quality REITs by H2 2027.
